description: Instant lookup and debugging guide for all HTTP status codes (1xx-5xx) with RFC specifications and troubleshooting advice.
faq_items: What is an HTTP status code?:::HTTP status codes are standard response codes issued by web servers to indicate whether a specific HTTP request was successfully completed.|||What is the difference between 401 and 403?:::401 Unauthorized means authentication is required or failed, while 403 Forbidden means the server understands who you are but refuses access.|||Is this guide offline and client-side?:::Yes, all status code lookups and specifications run entirely within your browser.
related_tools: cURL to Fetch Converter,DNS Lookup Tool,URL Parser & Query String Extractor

faq_items: How do I align items vertically in Flexbox?:::Use `align-items: center` for single-line flex containers, or `align-content: center` for multi-line wrapped containers.|||What does flex-grow do?:::It defines the ability for a flex item to grow if necessary, specifying how much remaining container space it should take up.|||Can I copy the generated CSS?:::Yes, click 'Copy CSS' to copy the container and item rules directly to your clipboard.

description: Convert JSON payloads into clean, idiomatic Rust struct definitions with Serde derive macros and field annotations.
faq_items: Does this generate Serde derives?:::Yes, generated structs automatically include `#[derive(Default, Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]`.|||How are nested JSON objects handled?:::Nested objects are recursively parsed into separate, strongly typed Rust structs.|||Are field names converted to snake_case?:::Yes, JSON camelCase keys are converted to Rust snake_case with `#[serde(rename = "...")]` attributes.

description: Instantly transform JSON objects into idiomatic Go structs complete with struct tags for JSON serialization.

description: Find the exact Git commands for your scenario: undoing commits, branching, stashing, rebasing, and disaster recovery.
faq_items: How do I undo the last commit without losing changes?:::Run `git reset --soft HEAD~1`. Your changes will remain staged in the index.|||How do I discard all local uncommitted changes?:::Run `git restore .` and `git clean -fd` to remove untracked files.|||Are these commands safe?:::Each command in this cheatsheet is labeled with its safety level (Safe, Modifies, or Destructive).
